Omnia page shows 'Diabetes Care Portal' title
Omnia login dialog opens when clicking 'Login / Sign Up to Continue'

Omnia card is visible on homepage with teal background (rgb(13, 148, 136))

omnia_welcome_screen.details: Welcome screen shows Diabetes Care Portal title, 4 feature cards (Blood Sugar Tracking, Diabetic Diet Plans, Emergency Guidance, Book Tests), Login button, and medical disclaimer.

omnia_login_dialog.details: Login dialog opens with 'Welcome to Omnia' title, phone input with +91 prefix, Send OTP button. OTP verification uses Twilio SMS.

omnia_homepage_card.details: Omnia card visible on homepage with teal background (#0D9488), Omnia logo, and 'Get Started' button.

omnia_footer_listing.details: Omnia listed in footer under 'Our Services' as 'Omnia Diabetes Care' with link to /omnia.

omnia_backend_apis.details: All Omnia API endpoints return 401 without auth as expected. Fixed user['id'] -> user.id bug in 6 endpoints.

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Backend Omnia endpoints were using user['id'] instead of user.id for Pydantic User model - caused 500 errors
Fixed: Added proper authentication checks (if not user: raise HTTPException) to all Omnia endpoints
Note: Omnia.js is 1218 lines - large but acceptable for feature-rich module with diet plans, sugar logging, tests booking, warning signs, and emergency guide
Note: Authenticated tests skipped because Twilio SMS is configured - cannot verify OTP in automated testing

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 passed, 8 skipped due to SMS OTP)

seed_data_creation: None required - tests use existing auth flow
